• Dimensions 19" x 13.5" x 6.75
  • Made from high quality vegan leather, premium metal hardware, and durable construction.
  • Dual carry options: tote handles or detachable cross-body strap
  • Large access opening with magnetic closure
  • Front and back exterior quick access slip pockets
  • Overall bag structure helps protects contents
  • Metal feet to help reduce scuffing

Front Compartment :
This space features one large interior zippered pocket and two medium interior slip pockets, making it perfect for storing toys, coloring books and other activities your kids might need to keep them entertained during sacrament meeting.

Center Compartment :
Here's where convenience meets cleanliness. Two easy-access water bottle pockets flank a central zip compartment featuring a spill-resistant liner. It isn't just for snacks and drinks; it's a spill-proof zone, making it easy to clean up any accidental spills from sippy cups and keeping crumbs contained!

Back Compartment :
Tailored just for you, this compartment is a sanctuary for your essentials. It boasts a large interior zippered pocket for secure storage, slip pockets to keep your phone and pens handy, and a metal key clip for quick access. It also includes a padded laptop compartment that ensures your tech, up to 16" in size, stays protected and easily accessible.

settings.heading: What are the dimensions of the bag?
I don't have small kids. Can I still use The Church Bag?
settings.content: Absolutely! While we did design it with busy moms in mind, there is nothing "kid-specific" about this bag that you wouldn't be able to find plenty of other uses for. The Church Bag is for everyone!

settings.heading: How many pockets does it have?
settings.content: Team, we love pockets, and we love organization. The Church Bag comes equipped with a variety of 10+ individual organizational features like zippered pockets, slip pockets, pen pockets, a device sleeve, and so much more! (You're welcome!)
